rulings.restated: Enter the amount from qbi helper "Select Form 8995 or dividend-only Form 8995-A".
rulings.model: The selection tests only the taxable-income threshold. The IRS also requires "You aren't a patron in a specified agricultural or horticultural cooperative" to use Form 8995, and no refusal or helper addresses that condition.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; project retained. Agricultural or horticultural cooperative patronage is refused by the QBI screen (`forms/2025/qbi.yaml`: 'Any QBI beyond section 199A dividends ... or agricultural/horticultural cooperative patronage?'), so a filer who reaches this selection is not a patron and the Form 8995 condition holds.
